title: HTML: HyperText Markup Language
supports: HTML overview; element guides; authoring guides; compatibility and examples
explanation: A practical reference and learning guide for HTML elements, attributes, usage patterns, browser compatibility, and authoring examples. Use an element reference page to confirm syntax and limitations before adapting an example.
example: Before using a newer interactive element, review its MDN element reference and compatibility notes, then test the behavior in the browsers your project supports.
